findings.text: the emitted route_upper_bound_note still asserts "each route error is an upper bound and each margin a lower bound" — the exact reading commit 47c9e501 corrected in the record and which this same function's docstring at lines 803-809 now denies ("it is not an upper bound") — and reports/nova/s19-local/exact-gauss-repairs/row-margin-table.json ships the false note in a machine-readable field, so the corrected record and the receipt it cites disagree.

the cited receipts do not resolve as written: the base arm is at reports/nova/s19-local/exact-gauss-order/default-route-base.npz (a sibling of the -repairs directory, not a subdirectory of it), the cited edge-order-rows/ directory does not exist, and the identity log sits on disk under the literal name default-*.log, so none of the three citations resolves; the manifest's evidence_inputs also attributes the base arm to the main tree at 38b7014e where the captured arm is the main tree's order-3 state at 700d8686, and an auditor sent to 38b7014e would not reproduce the comparison.

nothing fails if the headline repair regresses: no test references row_margin_table or other_error_term, so the field the record exists to repair is exercised only by the run itself and a reintroduced factor of ten would ship green.

the record says "Four commits carry this pass" and names four while the range 38b7014e..4b5c2944 holds five, the fifth (4b5c2944) named nowhere in either record, so a reader diffing the run cannot reconcile the count.
